name: Streamarr
description: Stream Usenet content on demand through the Streamarr Core Server. Thin adapter — no download-to-disk.
overview: Surfaces the Streamarr Core Server's Usenet search results inside Jellyfin and makes them playable through Jellyfin's transcoding pipeline.
changelog: Add a Files page with a unified storage overview (disk, segment cache, pre-downloads, NZB cache, ephemeral sessions) alongside cached-release and ephemeral-file management. Add per-scope playback-range tracking that folds front-end watch heartbeats into watched/buffered timeline data, surfaced through a new segmented timeline rail in the Sessions view. Add rotating, revocable admin refresh-token sessions for browser auth instead of long-lived cookies. Harden Jellyfin PlaybackInfo handling against clients that resend a closed LiveStreamId (observed with Swiftfin's rebuilt player), clearing only truly-dead stream ids and defaulting AutoOpenLiveStream when a client expresses no preference. Rework the Sessions page into a dedicated module with grid and table views.
